summary: Record the existing B.1.1 rate contract audit and its offline hardening regressions.

payload.markdown: - Stage B.1.1 audit hardened the V2 native denominator, unknown and excluded fluxes, local propagation to signed sources and optional output/run/input bindings. Both Windows trees passed 268 focused tests and one archived Zacros parser test. Eight live Zacros cases were deselected. The synthetic Ni/Cu pair and mean-per-site interpretation is evidence-bound in reports/multiphase/stage_b1_1_audit/reference_site.md. Scientific qualification and execution gates remain with their owners.
